# Kakar Adi Kali Sahasranama

> A free reading edition of the Kakar Adi Kali Sahasranama: 1,000 names of Maa Kali,
> each with Devanagari, IAST, the source transliteration, alternate spellings and a meaning.
> Arranged in ten sets of one hundred. Static HTML, no tracking, no paywall.

## Main pages

- [The reader](https://kakaradikalisahasranama.com/): frontispiece and the opening eleven names.
- [All 1,000 names](https://kakaradikalisahasranama.com/names/): the full index, searchable.
- [What it is](https://kakaradikalisahasranama.com/kakaradi-kali-sahasranama/): the text, why devotees read it, quick FAQ.
- [Recitation](https://kakaradikalisahasranama.com/kali-sahasranama-lyrics/): the names in sequence.
- [Practice](https://kakaradikalisahasranama.com/kali-sahasranama-benefits/): what a reading is for.
- [Print](https://kakaradikalisahasranama.com/kali-sahasranama-pdf/): printing from the browser.
- [Sources](https://kakaradikalisahasranama.com/sources/): transliteration and editorial method.

## Structure

Ten sets of one hundred, in order:

- Names 1-100 through 901-1000: /names/1-100/ ... /names/901-1000/
- One page per distinct name: /names/<slug>/

## Source

The Sanskrit text is the kakArAdi kAlI sahasranAma stotram (also kAlI medhAsAmrAjyaprada sahasranAma),
hosted by Sanskrit Documents: https://sanskritdocuments.org/doc_devii/kaaliisahasra.html
That edition is for personal study; it is cited and linked here, not republished.

## Related

- [Names 1-111 with one-line meanings](https://jaikhyapaparampara.com/articles/kakaradi-kali-sahasranama-names-1-111-one-line-meanings/): the opening section, published by the same parampara.
- [MANTRINI japa app](https://mantrini.jaikhyapaparampara.com/): free, offline, 108-bead japa counter with an Adya Mahakali altar; the record stays on the device.

## Notes

- Text is public and free to copy; readers are expected to copy it.
- No analytics, no cookies, no third-party requests.
